title: Trump: Ukraine needs a new leader
ticker: BREAKING: Trump says "it's time for Ukraine to get a new president"
Elon Musk: "I agree, it's time for Ukraine to get a new leader"
Zelensky: "It's up to our people to choose"
Zelensky offers elections if Russia agrees to a 60-day total ceasefire
Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia kills 20, including three children

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Good evening, and welcome to KOWEN News.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: President Trump has called for Ukraine to *replace Volodymyr Zelensky*.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Elon Musk quickly backed him, writing that it's *time for Ukraine to get a new leader*.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: And Zelensky has fired back, saying the choice belongs to *the Ukrainian people*.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Tonight: what Trump said, why Musk jumped in, how Kyiv is answering, and what it means for *peace talks*.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: It all comes one day after Trump's *diesel deal with Russia*. Here's the story.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Speaking to reporters at the White House on Saturday, President Trump lashed out at Zelensky over Ukraine's *strikes on Russian oil refineries*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: He said the strikes have hurt global *diesel supplies*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: He wants to make problems for *our farmers, our ranchers* with diesel fuel, Trump said, because Russia supplies a large portion of the diesel fuel throughout the world.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump said he had told Zelensky directly. Don't hit refineries. There's plenty of targets. And he went out and he hit.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: *He better damn well stop*, Trump said.

scenes.name: Donald Trump
scenes.quote: I think it's time for Ukraine to get a new president.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Then came the line that made headlines around the world. I think it's *time for Ukraine to get a new president*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: I suggest they get a new leader who can make a deal, he added, because he could have made many deals, but for some reason, *he never does*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump did not say who he thinks should *replace* Zelensky.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Under Ukraine's *martial law*, national elections are suspended while the war goes on.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: This is not the first time Trump has questioned Zelensky's legitimacy.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: In February 2025, he called Zelensky *a dictator without elections*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Days later, their meeting in the Oval Office turned into a *shouting match* in front of the cameras, and Zelensky left the White House early.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Washington and Kyiv later signed a minerals deal and patched things up, but this weekend's comments are the most direct call yet for Ukraine to *change its leader*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump later added that Zelensky *should have an election*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: For weeks, Trump has been urging Zelensky to *stop attacking* Russian energy infrastructure.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: U.S. diesel prices are near *record highs*, driven up by the U.S. war with Iran, and they've become a political problem for Republicans ahead of next month's midterms.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump has sought to blame those prices on Ukraine's strikes, rather than on the *war in Iran*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: On Friday, he struck a deal with Vladimir Putin to buy *Russian diesel*, easing U.S. sanctions to make it possible.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: That came just weeks after he signed a sweeping new *Russia sanctions law*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The deal was announced while Ukrainian and European officials were in *Miami*, meeting U.S. negotiators on a plan to end the war.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Ukraine said the timing was no coincidence. Zelensky said the deal had *emboldened Moscow*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: And according to Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov, Putin used the call to *reject* peace talks, saying Russia would keep fighting until its goals are achieved.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Hours after the deal, Ukraine struck *a major Russian oil hub* again.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Within hours, one of the world's richest men joined the attack.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Elon Musk, who led the Trump administration's cost cutting effort known as *DOGE* last year, took to his own platform, X.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Elon Musk responded on X to a video of Trump's refinery comments.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Zelensky, he wrote, *has gone too far*.

scenes.name: Elon Musk
scenes.post: I agree, it's time for Ukraine to get a new leader.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: In another comment, Musk went further, echoing the president almost word for word.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: I agree, *it's time for Ukraine to get a new leader*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: It is not the first time Musk has turned on Zelensky.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: In November 2024, Musk joined a phone call between then president elect Trump and Zelensky, who *thanked him* for Starlink internet access in Ukraine.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: But by February 2025, Musk was accusing Zelensky of running a *massive graft machine* feeding off the dead bodies of Ukrainian soldiers.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Now, he is openly backing the call for Zelensky to *step aside*.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Kyiv did not stay quiet.

scenes.name: Andrii Sybiha
scenes.quote: He has the support of the Ukrainian people, and they have the right to decide.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Ukraine's foreign minister, Andrii Sybiha, defended Zelensky on X.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: He has the support of the Ukrainian people, Sybiha wrote, and *they have the right to decide*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Statements from abroad, he added, only confirm that *he is doing his job well*.

scenes.name: Volodymyr Zelensky
scenes.quote: With all respect to President Trump, it's up to our society, up to our people to choose one or another leader.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: On Sunday, Zelensky answered Trump himself, in an interview with *ABC News*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: With all respect to President Trump, he said, it's up to our society, *up to our people* to choose one or another leader.

scenes.name: Volodymyr Zelensky
scenes.quote: Please tell Putin to give us two months, 60 days of total ceasefire, and we will organise elections.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Ukraine has not held a national election since Russia's full scale invasion in 2022.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Zelensky said he had a message for Trump's team. If they really want elections, please tell Putin to give us *sixty days of total ceasefire*, and we will organise elections.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: He also offered a trade on the refinery strikes. Don't attack us. Don't kill our children. *We will stop attacking your diesel*.

scenes.name: Zaporizhzhia
scenes.quote: 20 killed, including 3 children. The third mass-casualty attack on Ukraine in four days.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The war itself shows no sign of slowing. On Saturday, a Russian attack on the city of Zaporizhzhia killed *twenty people*, including three children.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Zelensky linked it directly to the diesel deal. Today, he said, Russia said *thank you* for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports, by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Earlier in the week, nearly *eighty civilians* were killed in Russian strikes, including at least thirty by a bomb in Kramatorsk, and twenty two by a missile in Pryluky, east of Kyiv.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: It was the *third mass casualty attack* on Ukraine in four days.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Zelensky warned that every extra *billion dollars* Russia earns from exports will pay for weapons, drones and missiles.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: He said he had spoken with French President Emmanuel Macron about *air defense*, and that Ukraine would receive new ammunition for its F-16 fighter jets.

scenes.name: Allies react
scenes.quote: Britain says it will strengthen sanctions on Russia. Republican Rep. Don Bacon: apply more sanctions, not fewer.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Ukraine's European allies have expressed dismay at the Russian deal, and say they stand by their sanctions.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham spoke with Zelensky on Saturday, and London said it would *strengthen its sanctions* on Russia.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: In Washington, Republican Congressman Don Bacon said it was time to apply *more sanctions*, not roll them back.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: So what happens now?

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Ukrainian, European and American negotiators have been working in *Miami* on a common proposal to end the war.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: But with Washington buying Russian diesel and calling for Zelensky's exit, Kyiv's trust in that process is being *tested*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Zelensky says Ukraine still needs *American support*, and hopes this dispute won't break the unity of Ukraine's allies.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: In the U.S., all eyes are on the *midterm elections* on November third, where high fuel prices could cost Republicans.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Whether Trump's pressure on Zelensky helps or hurts at the ballot box, we'll know in *three weeks*. Reporting for KOWEN News.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: To recap tonight's top story.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: President Trump says it's time for Ukraine to get a *new president*, blaming Zelensky's refinery strikes for high diesel prices.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Elon Musk agrees. Zelensky says the decision belongs to *Ukrainians*, and offers elections if Russia accepts a sixty day ceasefire.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Ukraine's foreign minister says criticism from abroad only shows Zelensky *is doing his job*.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: And in Zaporizhzhia, a Russian strike killed *twenty people*, a day after the diesel deal.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Meanwhile, Russian strikes on Ukrainian cities *continue*.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: We'll keep following this story. That's all for tonight. This has been KOWEN News. Thanks for watching, and good night.
